name: Loading bar fun
summary: Chunky striped loading bar with moving stripes, a counting percentage and a playful label that changes.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; bar is 880 px wide at s = 1

params.name: labels
params.default: loading brain...|warming up the snacks|almost there
params.note: playful labels separated by |, shown in turn as the bar fills

params.name: len
params.note: frames for the bar to fill from 0 to 100%

params.name: color
params.note: bar colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

example.labels: loading brain...|warming up the snacks|almost there

author: krakujs
